items.prompt: I'm going ___ a new laptop next month.

explanation.en: Going to is followed by to + base verb.
explanation.es: Después de going: to + verbo base.

optionNotes.en: To is missing: it must be going to buy.
Going to is not followed by an -ing form.

items.prompt: My brother and his wife ___ going to live in Bristol next year.

explanation.en: The subject is plural (they), so use are.

optionNotes.en: Correct: plural subject + are going to.
Is does not agree with two people.
Do is not used to build going to.

items.prompt: She ___ going to come to the meeting. She has a bad cold.

explanation.en: The negative of going to is isn't going to.
explanation.es: La negativa es isn't going to, no doesn't.

optionNotes.en: Doesn't would be followed by the base verb: doesn't come.
Not alone is missing the verb be.

items.prompt: A: ___ you going to go to the party? B: Yes, I am. Are you?

explanation.en: Questions with going to begin with am, is or are.

optionNotes.en: Do cannot be followed by going to.
Have is not used to form this structure.

items.prompt: Look at those black clouds. It's ___ to rain.

explanation.en: It's is it is, so the structure is it is going to + base verb.

optionNotes.en: Goes does not follow it is.

items.prompt: Next year, I ___ to study medicine in Madrid.

explanation.en: Going to needs am, is or are and the -ing form going.
explanation.es: I am going to + verbo: «voy a estudiar».

optionNotes.en: Correct: I am going to study.
Go needs -ing in this structure: going.
Going alone needs am in front of it.
